% PGF manual, pgfmanual-en-tikz-paths.tex:391-392. Its single control
% is written twice explicitly so this gate measures corners, not shorthand parsing.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[rounded corners] (0,0) -- (1,1)
    -- (2,0) .. controls (3,1) and (3,1) .. (4,0);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
